purpose: Establish a seed-supported sufficient-diversity point after M2048 passed only 2/3 model-library seeds at the matched checkpoint horizon.

triggering_evidence.M2048_replicate_2_only_failure: k=15 noisy-risk ratio 1.201642 versus the frozen strict <1.2 gate
triggering_evidence.existing_M4096_reference: replicate 0, step 290000, maximum all-prefix noisy-risk ratio 1.0526

design.pairing: For each replicate, reuse the exact model and training seed derivation from the completed M1024/M2048 pair. Copy the retained M2048 tensor library verbatim as the first 2048 rows, then append 2048 Gaussian tensors from a new replicate-keyed extension stream.
design.architecture: PublishedRegressor: q=8, 16 points, 8 layers, width 128, 2 heads, MLP hidden 512
design.training_distribution: Uniform sampling from the finite Gaussian library; iid N(0,I8) covariates; iid N(0,0.25) label noise; loss over all 16 x-token predictions.
design.optimizer: Adam, batch 256, peak learning rate 0.001, linear warmup to step 250000 and linear decay against a nominal 500000-step horizon

frozen_evaluation.primary_metric: Transformer/ridge noisy-target risk ratio at every prefix
frozen_evaluation.per_model_gate: PASS iff the point estimate is <1.2 at all four prefixes
frozen_evaluation.trajectory_role: Secondary fixed-time description only; no best-checkpoint selection may replace the primary endpoint.
frozen_evaluation.same_prompt_bank: Reuse the accepted 4096-prompt bank without regeneration, subsetting, or reordering.

frozen_outcomes.seed_supported_M4096_sufficient_point: Both new M4096 models pass. Report M4096 as a 3/3 observed sufficient-diversity point, M1024 as 0/3, and M2048 as a mixed 2/3 transition condition. Do not convert 3/3 into a population-confidence claim.
frozen_outcomes.M4096_not_seed_robust: At least one new M4096 model fails. Do not claim a seed-supported M4096 sufficient point; retain the per-seed trajectories and move the upper-dose check to M8192 only if further compute is justified.
frozen_outcomes.nonmonotone_or_transient: If a model passes earlier fixed checkpoints but fails at step 290000, report transient competence or later specialization without selecting the earlier checkpoint as the endpoint result.

integrity.checkpoint_contents: model, Adam state, training generator, CPU RNG, CUDA RNG, identity and step

pre_execution_technical_amendment.trigger: A local smoke test showed that regenerating the historical library from the old seed is not bit-stable across PyTorch builds.
pre_execution_technical_amendment.correction: Construct M4096 by concatenating the retained M2048 tensor bytes with a separately seeded 2048-row Gaussian extension, and verify the prefix with torch.equal.
pre_execution_technical_amendment.scope: Made before any new training outcome. Architecture, endpoint, optimizer, prompt bank, gate and frozen interpretations are unchanged.

limits: Three observed seeds at M4096 are a focused robustness check, not a precise population estimate.
This stage can repair the empirical upper bound, not erase or relabel the preregistered M2048 failure.
Checkpoint trajectories test optimization-time sensitivity but do not establish a new mechanism.
